# 📋 Test Matrix: Reports Page (Generated by Writer, Phase 1)

**Classification:** QA Documentation (No Code)
**Objective:** Map every UI element on the Reports page (`6_Reports.py`) to Happy-Path and Adversarial test cases with DB Pincer assertions, following the Enterprise QA Master Plan Phase 1.

---

## 🧪 Test Cases

| TestID | View | UI Element | Happy-Path Description | Adversarial Scenario | DB Validation (DB Pincer) | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| TC-REP-001 | 6_Reports | Global Filters – Date Range | Select date range via sidebar `st.date_input`; verify analytical tables filter by date range | Select end date before start date; select dates far in the future with no data | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE intake_date BETWEEN start AND end;` Verify UI table row count matches DB count for filtered range. | new |
| TC-REP-002 | 6_Reports | Global Filters – Species Multiselect | Select one or more species via sidebar `st.multiselect`; verify analytical data filters to selected species | Select all species then deselect all; select species with zero eggs; attempt to inject via URL | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg e JOIN intake i ON e.intake_id = i.intake_id JOIN species s ON i.species_id = s.species_id WHERE s.species_code IN (selected);` Verify UI count matches DB. | new |
| TC-REP-003 | 6_Reports | WormD Export – Mother Case Selection | Select one or more mother cases via `st.multiselect`; verify selections populate | Select nonexistent case IDs via URL; select case with all terminal eggs (SX/SD); select empty case | `SELECT intake_id, intake_name FROM intake WHERE is_deleted=false;` Verify multiselect options match active intakes. | new |
| TC-REP-004 | 6_Reports | WormD Export – Checkbox Options (bins, eggs, egg_obs, bin_obs, hatchling) | Toggle each checkbox on/off; verify START generates correct payload structure with only selected sections | Rapid toggle all checkboxes; manipulate checkbox state via JavaScript | No DB change during preview. Verify JSON bundle includes only checked sections. Verify CSV columns correspond to checked sections. | new |
| TC-REP-005 | 6_Reports | WormD Export – START button | Click START with at least one mother case selected; verify CSV and JSON payloads generated and previewed | Click START with no cases selected (warning expected); double-click START causing duplicate generation; click START during active DB write | `SELECT * FROM system_log WHERE action='wormd_export_bundle' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute';` Verify audit log entry created with observer_id and session_id. | new |
| TC-REP-006 | 6_Reports | WormD Export – CSV Download | After generation, click CSV download button; verify file downloads with correct `wormd_intake_cases.csv` name and content matches preview | Download before generation; download with empty data; concurrent downloads | File content must match `st.session_state._wormd_csv`. Verify CSV row count equals selected mother cases × included sections. | new |
| TC-REP-007 | 6_Reports | WormD Export – JSON Download | After generation, click JSON download button; verify `wormd_intake_bundle.json` downloads with valid JSON structure | Download corrupted JSON (memory manipulation); download with large dataset (50+ cases) | File content must match `st.session_state._wormd_json`. `json.loads()` must succeed without errors. | new |
| TC-REP-008 | 6_Reports | WormD Biosecurity Gate (S6-YA3) | Verify only S6-YA3 eggs are included in WormD export bundle; verify S6-YA1/YA2 eggs are excluded | Attempt to force lower-stage export via URL parameter; manipulate stage_id in session state | `SELECT egg_id FROM egg WHERE stage_id='S6' AND sub_stage='YA3' AND is_deleted=false;` Verify export only contains these eggs. `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE stage_id='S6' AND sub_stage IN ('YA1','YA2');` Verify these are NOT in export. | new |
| TC-REP-009 | 6_Reports | Critical Stage Analysis tab | Open "Critical Stage Analysis" tab; verify table shows egg counts grouped by stage and status; verify Plotly chart renders | No active eggs in database (empty table); all eggs at same stage; rapid tab switching | `SELECT current_stage, status, COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE is_deleted=false GROUP BY current_stage, status;` Verify UI table matches DB aggregation. | new |
| TC-REP-010 | 6_Reports | Mortality Chart (Plotly) | Verify mortality donut/pie chart renders with correct distribution of SX/SD vs active eggs; verify chart is interactive | All eggs active (no mortality — chart should still render); single egg in database | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE status IN ('Dead','Non-Viable') AND is_deleted=false;` `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM egg WHERE is_deleted=false;` Verify chart segments match DB proportions. | new |
| TC-REP-011 | 6_Reports | Hatch Success Correlation tab | Open "Hatch Success" tab; verify `incubation_duration_days` histogram renders from `hatchling_ledger` data | No hatchling records (info message expected); incubation_duration_days column missing or NULL for all records | `SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(incubation_duration_days) FROM hatchling_ledger WHERE is_deleted=false;` Verify chart data matches DB aggregate. | new |
| TC-REP-012 | 6_Reports | Sidebar Report Filters – Apply | Change global filter date range or species selection; verify both analysis tabs refresh with filtered data | Rapid filter changes (debounce testing); select filter combination yielding zero results | Repeat TC-REP-001/TC-REP-002 DB queries with same filters; verify UI aggregations match filtered DB results. | new |
| TC-REP-013 | 6_Reports | Bin Code Display in Exports | Verify exported CSV/JSON includes `bin_code` column (human-readable) alongside numeric `bin_id` for reference | Bin with null bin_code; bin_code containing special characters (commas, quotes) | `SELECT bin_id, bin_code FROM bin WHERE is_deleted=false;` Verify export columns match DB columns. CSV escaping must handle special characters. | new |
| TC-REP-014 | 6_Reports | system_log Export Audit Entry | After any export, verify `system_log` row created with action='wormd_export_bundle', observer_id, session_id, and timestamp | Export without observer_id (session corruption); duplicate log entries from rapid START clicks | `SELECT * FROM system_log WHERE action='wormd_export_bundle' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;` Verify observer_id NOT NULL, session_id NOT NULL, created_at is recent. | new |

---

**Writer Notes:** All test cases derived from targeted grep of `6_Reports.py` and aligned with Requirements §4.5 (Bin Closure Audit), §4.6 (Biosecurity Export Gate S6-YA3 minimum), §9 (High-Fidelity QA), and implied system objective. DB Pincer assertions follow the 'Zero Mocking Tolerance' rule. Existing MASTER_TEST_MATRIX.csv entries (TC-REP-001 through TC-REP-003) expanded with granular UI-element-level coverage.
